title: VPN & Proxy Security Checklist - Complete Privacy Setup Guide
metaDescription: Essential VPN and proxy security checklist to protect your online privacy. Learn best practices, avoid risks, and secure your connection.
intro: Secure your online privacy with this comprehensive VPN and proxy security checklist. Whether you're new to privacy tools or want to audit your current setup, follow these essential steps to protect your data and maintain anonymity online.

items.task: Choose a reputable VPN provider with a proven no-logs policy
items.why: Free VPNs often sell your data or contain malware. Paid services with verified no-logs policies protect your privacy better.
items.howTo: Research providers like ExpressVPN, NordVPN, or Surfshark. Look for independent audits, jurisdiction outside 5/9/14 Eyes countries, and transparent privacy policies.

items.why: If your VPN connection drops, a kill switch prevents your real IP from being exposed to websites or your ISP.
items.howTo: In your VPN app settings, find and enable 'Kill Switch' or 'Network Lock'. Test it by disconnecting your VPN mid-browsing session.

items.task: Use the most secure VPN protocol available
items.why: Different protocols offer varying levels of security and speed. Modern protocols provide better encryption and performance.
items.howTo: Choose WireGuard or OpenVPN in your VPN settings. Avoid outdated protocols like PPTP or L2TP. Enable automatic protocol selection if unsure.

items.task: Verify DNS leak protection is active
items.why: DNS leaks can reveal your browsing activity to your ISP even when using a VPN, compromising your privacy.
items.howTo: Enable DNS leak protection in VPN settings. Test for leaks at dnsleaktest.com or ipleak.net while connected to your VPN.

items.task: Choose the right proxy type for your needs
items.why: Different proxy types offer varying levels of anonymity. SOCKS5 and HTTPS proxies provide better security than HTTP proxies.
items.howTo: Use SOCKS5 proxies for general browsing and torrenting. Choose HTTPS proxies for web browsing. Avoid free HTTP proxies for sensitive activities.

items.why: Authentication prevents unauthorized users from accessing your proxy connection and adds an extra security layer.
items.howTo: Configure username and password authentication in your proxy settings. Use unique, strong credentials different from other accounts.

items.why: Improper proxy configuration can lead to data leaks or connection failures, exposing your real IP address.
items.howTo: Set proxy in browser network settings or use Incognito Browser for automatic proxy management. Test configuration at whatismyipaddress.com.

items.task: Verify your IP address is properly masked
items.why: Confirming your IP is hidden ensures your VPN or proxy is working correctly and your location remains private.
items.howTo: Visit whatismyip.com or similar sites before and after connecting. Your IP and location should change to match your VPN/proxy server.

items.why: WebRTC can expose your real IP address even when using VPN or proxy, compromising your anonymity.
items.howTo: Visit browserleaks.com/webrtc and check for IP leaks. Disable WebRTC in browser settings or use Incognito Browser with built-in protection.

items.why: Slow or unstable connections may indicate server issues or encourage users to disconnect their privacy protection.
items.howTo: Run speed tests at speedtest.net with VPN/proxy on and off. Try different server locations if speeds are significantly reduced.

items.task: Consider using multi-hop or double VPN features
items.why: Routing traffic through multiple servers adds extra encryption layers and makes it harder to trace your connection.
items.howTo: Enable 'Double VPN' or 'Multi-hop' in your VPN app if available. Note this may reduce connection speed but increases anonymity.

items.task: Set up Tor over VPN for maximum anonymity
items.why: Combining Tor with VPN provides the highest level of anonymity by layering different privacy technologies.
items.howTo: Connect to your VPN first, then launch Tor Browser. Some VPN providers offer dedicated Tor over VPN servers for easier setup.

items.task: Perform monthly privacy and security audits
items.why: Regular audits help identify new vulnerabilities, leaks, or changes in your privacy setup that need attention.
items.howTo: Monthly, test for IP/DNS leaks, check VPN logs, review proxy configurations, and update software. Use tools like privacytools.io for guidance.
